summary:
## Standing operator rules
- Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.
- Run “split-order-rules-package” between other work, in the specified order, one step at a time.
- While away for a meeting, carry on.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Always use db-stg-2; db-stg-1 is a decommissioned read-only replica, and config/staging.yaml is stale.
- Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py` causing customer-facing 400s. Invoice pagination is superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Per-invoice embedding was too slow (8.42s locally).
- Unbounded batching was replaced with 100-document chunks.
- Per-vector transactions were replaced with bulk upserts.
- Wrapping webhook handlers in a five-attempt retry decorator was ruled out because it resent customer emails multiple times.

## Recent work
Completed billing type annotations, corrected `build_invoice_lines` to return a list, preserved discount semantics, and made ledger timestamps timezone-aware. Billing tests passed (34), full tests passed (96), and mypy was clean. Split-order package steps 1–3 are complete; steps 4–8 remain. In a separate repository, found `apply_credit` likely deducts refunds in the wrong order and added a reusable `make_invoice` test helper; this issue remains unresolved.
